# Stephen Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** nearly fifty  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P26](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0026)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md) (parent), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) (spouse), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) (child)

## Appearance

Stephen Irving is a tall, handsome man of middle age with a strong, sad face that is splendidly modeled about the chin and brow. He has a full head of iron-gray hair and deep-set, dark blue eyes.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P26](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0026), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)_

## Personality

Stephen Irving is a high-strung, sensitive, and reserved man who scrupulously hides his deep and tender nature from the world. He is also noted for his pride, which prevents him from returning.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## History

Raised in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Stephen Irving was known as a nice though proud boy who grew up to be strong. After years apart, he asked [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to carry a message to Miss Lavendar about visiting her, which led to his arrival at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Following an affectionate reconciliation in the garden, Stephen married Miss Lavendar in a lovely ceremony attended by their friends before the newlyweds departed together.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P49](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0049), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P17](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0017), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), +8 more_

## Quotes

> "In Paul’s last letter he spoke of going with you to visit an old . . . friend of mine . . . Miss Lewis at the stone house in Grafton. Do you know her well?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P30](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0030)

> "Yes, I believe you are. Well, I am going to ask a favor of you. I would like to go and see Miss Lavendar if she will let me. Will you ask her if I may come?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035)

> “This is the one place where time stands still,” he said, looking around him with delighted eyes. “There is nothing changed about this house or garden since I was here twenty-five years ago. It makes me feel young again.”
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P60](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0060)

> "I hardly knew my boy, he had grown so big and brown and sturdy."
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P27](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0027)

> "So this is my little son’s ‘beautiful teacher,’ of whom I have heard so much"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023)

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

Stephen Irving and [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) were formerly engaged twenty-five years ago before eventually reuniting. Stephen reached out to her by sending a message through [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), leading to an affectionate reunion at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) where they reconciled. They subsequently married in a ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before departing together.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P17](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0017), +12 more_

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--stephen-irving.md)

Stephen Irving is the father of [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). While visiting [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Stephen asked [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to carry a message to Miss Lavendar to arrange a visit with her.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), +1 more_
